intro: Rare Earth is a specialized package of mineral-rich soil procured from Darnassus for botanic experiments on Teldrassil. It is sent via courier from Dolanaar to the herbalist researcher Denalan at his lakeside camp near Lake Al'Ameth.

p: Teldrassil's newly grown ecosystem requires careful observation and nurturing, prompting herbalists across the island to study how various plants respond to foreign or enriched soils. This particular parcel of rare earth was requisitioned directly from Darnassus by Denalan, an eccentric botanist stationed along the eastern shore of Lake Al'Ameth. After languishing in transit and turning up late in Dolanaar, herbalist Syral Bladeleaf entrusts travelers passing south to deliver the perishable soil to Denalan before its potency fades.
